<!-- pr-reviewer: 4112662014e097eafb3dd6ba3446b7d1538640c4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

**What looks good**
- Merges cleanly with current main (trial merge, no conflicts). Diff is additive only: 5 new `src/bin` files, `cl::text`, 5 `tests/headless_bin.rs`, one decision note. No Cargo.toml, build.rs, .github or script changes, so no new dependencies.
- Layering holds: none of geometry/cl/tools/sim/motion depends on camcraft-app or camcraft-ui.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in any bin or in `cl::text` (only `unwrap_or`). The one index site (`geometry` bin, bytes[80..84]) is guarded by `len() >= 84`, and the facet count uses `checked_mul`/`checked_add`. Errors print `<bin>: <msg>` and exit non-zero.
- `cl::text` round trip: `cl_text_round_trips_every_golden` reads every `crates/app/tests/golden/*.cl` and writes it back byte for byte (CRLF normalised), which pins the "matches the golden writer" claim against the committed goldens.
- The sim bin labels its output honestly: `verdict: ok (rapid and depth check only - no part, no gouge verdict)`. It makes no gouge claim.
- All new modules carry provenance lines; all new files are well under 400 lines (largest 243).

**Local results (merged with main)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-cl lib | 26 passed |
| cl headless_bin | 3 passed (incl. golden round trip) |
| camcraft-geometry lib / headless_bin | 38 / 3 passed |
| camcraft-tools headless_bin | 3 passed |
| camcraft-sim headless_bin | 3 passed |
| camcraft-motion headless_bin | 2 passed |
| clippy -D warnings, 5 crates, --all-targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `feat`: per Issue Law it merges at the next minor cut, not before.
- The body carries a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #32`. Binaries are deliberately kept out of the release zip (documented in `docs/decisions/32-headless-bins.md`).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
